acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Gargoyles family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Grotesque, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Perch-Drop Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Small perched chipped-sandstone figure with crude features and wings too small to be useful for flight.
Signature mechanic: Chipped Drop: the perched Grotesque releases both claws for a low body slam, then scrapes back to its pedestal fragment.
battlefieldDuty: Probe approach timing with one short drop from a low architectural perch.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity carved stone, moss and water staining, amber rune glow and amber seam glow, bronze, and water-spout architecture remain source-supported masonry, weathering, ornament, and restrained animation—not Earth, Water, Fire, or any other affinity.
Mortar, pedestal fragments, relief detail, horns, claws, and folded wings retain architectural load paths with no elemental substitution.
counterplay: Leave the short drop lane and strike the loaded toe or tiny wing root during the scrape back. Affinity signal: The established perch chip, mortar joint, amber hinge seam, tracery brace, or throne-pedestal bond remains readable.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating native stone, staining, or spout design as affinity evidence
identityInvariants: Squat crouched construction, hunched shoulders, horned beast face, clawed grip, and folded architectural wings remain recognizable.
Sandstone, granite, marble, bronze, mortar, moss, and water staining remain discrete built materials rather than flesh.
Relief carving, water-spout mouths, restrained amber seams, and pedestal fragments preserve the architectural source grammar.
Stone quality and wing architecture escalate from useless carved flaps to sovereign buttresses while load-bearing joints stay readable.
telegraph: Crude features tilt down and dust falls from the chipped toe that bears the perch load.
